title: EyeMod
description: EyeMod adds living 3D eyes to player heads. They blink, glance, frown, and peer procedurally. Customize colors and positioning via an in-game screen. Fully client-side - no server mod needed. See others' eyes if they have the mod too!
body:
# EyeMod

EyeMod adds a pair of small, living 3D eyes to your player model. 

They are not just static textures. The eyes move, blink, and react on their own. They will glance around, narrow into a scrutinizing look, or clamp down into a frown. This happens procedurally and independently for every player, which helps make characters feel a bit more alive.

### Features

* **Customization:** There is an in-game calibration screen where you can adjust the height and vertical position to fit your specific skin.
* **Color control:** Use the HSV picker to customize the whites, pupils, and the skin-tone underlay. You can also use the built-in eyedropper to grab colors directly from your skin preview.
* **Client-side:** This mod does not require a server-side installation. As long as other players have the mod installed, you will see their eyes moving too.
* **Easy access:** You can open the settings at any time from the title screen, the pause menu, or the mods list. 

Everything you change saves automatically to your config folder. It is a simple way to add a bit of personality to your character.
